question: At equivalent initial-representative cumulative pollen service during environmental turnover, does abrupt versus gradual replacement of pollinator functional optima alter A-before-I evolution, realized genotype changes, or eventual persistence?

scheduled_window.after_window: both groups remain shifted4 from update 100 through update399
scheduled_window.abrupt_rule: matched4 for first k updates, intermediate lambda_star at update k, then shifted4 until t=99
scheduled_window.calibration: match sum of total delivered pollen across first100 updates under FIXED n48 clonal X=I=A=.5 reference using unchanged original reproduction kernel; one common calibration per synthetic history visitor profile, with finite-step bisection
scheduled_window.baseline_monotonicity_check: all 101 integer step lambdas must decrease reference delivered pollen, otherwise fail closed
scheduled_window.scope_limit: baseline calibration is NOT equal pollen across actual evolving genotype/census states

visitor_profile_variability.seeded_function: four independently seeded offsets Uniform(0,0.025), added to both starting and final functional optima; start and end stay within [0,1]
visitor_profile_variability.history_unit: one independent synthetic optima profile, four demographic repeats nested within same profile; do not treat all1024 trajectories as independent ecological histories

crossing.reference: actual diploid founder means, never relative to one evolved comparator
crossing.censoring: unreached, one-trait-only and extinct branches remain classified separately; no zero-coded extinct trait

endpoints.primary: per visitor-profile paired schedule difference in investment and assurance cumulative probabilities of first sustained founder-relative crossing by update100, with categorical A-first/I-first/tie/A-only/I-only/neither retained
secondary: paired per-profile A-minus-I crossing lag among jointly reached; censored kept visible
ancestral local focal full-W beta_A and beta_I sign paths at designated sampled times
investment, assurance and matching genotype means/variances at10,100,400
mean and range of pollen delivery and visitor functional overlap
original genotypic parentage and conditional pre-mutation mean shifts

inference.unit: 16 synthetic environmental-profile clusters; 4 demographic repeats nested
inference.method: two-sided cluster-level paired mean difference and descriptive percentile bootstrap, 9999 draws, fixed seed48272026, all 4 timing-cost settings and both mutation rates reported
inference.decision: Do NOT call the mechanism confirmed on source-selected repeated cells; new run exploratory/model-specific unless independent realistic/power-calibrated ecological external validation exists
inference.no_peeking_or_retuning: no profile/exposure/genetic/demographic parameter adjustment after outcome run; any failed CI must be corrected as engineering with source-preserving audit and full provenance

execution_policy.smoke: one profile x one repeat x two schedules x first40 updates; no evolutionary claim
execution_policy.full: all1024 trajectories plus SHA source/environment/founder receipts; main prereg endpoints must be computed only from complete full readout

scientific_limitations: The artificial replacement reduces fitness affinity by changing optima, not actual disappearance of pollinator individuals
The original Model3 has no dynamical pollinator dependence on floral investment and no spatial neighbor density
Equalized pollen supply is calculated for a fixed reference homozygous N48 population only, not for all evolving states or per maternal recipient
Reproductive updates are not calibrated to natural island years
This experiment manipulates functional matching chronology, not the natural genetic mutation-order of A and I loci
A small synthetic 16-profile cohort cannot establish universal evolutionary selection-order or island ecological survival
